seoTitle: Max-Morrys Agency — Product, AI, Technology & Brand
seoDescription: We build the digital products, AI systems and brand experiences businesses need to move forward. The Product, AI, Technology & Brand practice of MY ONOMA, from Dakar.

hero.subtitle: Product strategy, engineering, AI systems and brand experiences. We work on projects where product, technology and business have to work together.

whoWeHelp.subtitle: We don't take on every project. We take on the ones where a product decision drives a technical decision, and the other way round.

founders.title: Founders & startups
founders.desc: Going from an intuition to a product in production, without building what won't be used.

companies.title: SMEs & scale-ups
companies.desc: Tooling, automating and holding up when growth outgrows the systems in place.

institutions.title: Institutions & organisations
institutions.desc: Designing platforms that stay reliable, measurable and maintainable over time.

executives.title: Premium personal brands
executives.desc: Building the digital ecosystem of an expertise: positioning, platform, authority.

whoWeHelp.notFor: We are not a fixed-price web shop, a communications agency, or a full-service agency. If your need is primarily growth, acquisition or revenue, we'll point you to the practice that owns it.

product.name: Digital Product
product.tagline: From intent to product in production.
product.desc: We frame, design and build digital products: SaaS, business platforms, web applications, marketplaces, portals, internal tools. From prototype to running product.

ai.name: AI Systems & Automation
ai.tagline: AI tied to an actual problem.
ai.desc: We put AI where it changes something: an expensive workflow, a repeated task, a service that no longer holds up. Never AI for its own sake.
items: Agents and assistants inside your tools

technology.name: Technology & Infrastructure
technology.desc: Application architecture, integrations, APIs, authentication, payments, data and dashboards. Engineering in service of a measurable outcome.

brand.name: Brand & Executive Presence
brand.desc: Positioning, content architecture and digital platform for personal brands and executives. This site is the demonstration.

work.clientsDesc: Products built for third parties. They belong to their clients; we state only the role we held.
work.venturesDesc: Products the studio designs, owns and operates. Each one is a brand in its own right.

khanouss.description: Full-stack e-commerce platform — catalog, cart and checkout.

holycash.description: Web platform focused on financial services and payments.

english-lab.description: An English coaching platform for French-speaking African professionals and students.

resho-konnexion.description: Professional and community platform: jobs, events, incubator and directory.

klio-pro.description: Public site, ticketing and back-office for a procurement consulting and training firm in Dakar.

je-temoigne.description: Collection, moderation and publishing of testimonials in video, audio or text, straight from the phone.

lauraverse.description: Media platform and agenda of Christian events across French-speaking Africa.

dunamis-holydays.description: Event site: presentation, programme and registrations.

jubile-de-grace.description: Anniversary event site — programme, highlights and participation.

in-senegal.description: Institutional site for a national event — presentation, programme and contact.

frame.title: Frame
frame.desc: We start from the problem and the business decision, not a feature list. What won't be used doesn't get built.

design.title: Design
design.desc: Journeys, architecture and interface. Technical and product trade-offs are made together, not one after the other.

build.title: Build
build.desc: Regular, verifiable releases. You watch the product move rather than read a progress report.

run.title: Run
run.desc: Launch, measurement, fixes and evolution. A delivered product is not a finished product.

myOnoma.title: Max-Morrys Agency is the Product, AI, Technology & Brand practice of MY ONOMA.
myOnoma.body: MY ONOMA is a Digital Product & Growth Studio. It builds products and systems for clients, builds growth machines, and develops its own products.
myOnoma.legalNote: Engagements contracted under MY ONOMA are delivered by MY ONOMA SARL.
myOnoma.growBody: For Growth, Revenue & Operations engagements, we work within MY ONOMA alongside Cléa Growth Office. It is a sibling practice, not a subcontractor.
myOnoma.growDistinction: Max-Morrys Agency builds the systems. Cléa Growth Office builds and runs the growth machine.

items.q: How is this different from the Digital Presence offer?
items.a: Digital Presence is a productised offer for local businesses: website, Google listing, WhatsApp catalogue, regular publishing, at published prices. Max-Morrys Agency works on bespoke projects where product, technology and business are entangled. Two distinct offers, two distinct funnels.

No. Every engagement is scoped from a problem, a perimeter and a timeline. We work per project, on retainer, or in an advisory capacity. The form includes a budget range: it's there to check we're aligned before wasting your time.
Max-Morrys Agency is a commercial brand. Engagements contracted under MY ONOMA are delivered by MY ONOMA SARL, a Senegalese company based in Dakar.
Yes. The studio is based in Dakar and works remotely. Product and engineering don't depend on being on site; we align working rhythms with your time zone.

items.q: Do you use AI to build?
items.a: Yes — AI-assisted engineering, across code, tests and tooling. It speeds delivery up. It does not replace architecture trade-offs, review, or accountability for what ships.

Deliverables built for a client belong to that client, under the terms of their contract. Our methods, generic components and internal tooling remain ours. That boundary is explicit and written into our contracts.
